title: Card transaction spreadsheet turned into journal entries
prompt: Turn the attached card transaction spreadsheet into journal entries using its category column for the expense account, and propose them for the card account.

setup.q: Which chart-of-accounts name does each category in the spreadsheet map to?
Which liability account is the card?
Which account takes a line whose category is not in the map until a person decides?

inputs.name: Chart of accounts and the card account ledger

steps: read the period-lock state and the chart of accounts
run column_map over the spreadsheet: date, description, amount, category; stop with a question if a required column is ambiguous
map each category with categoryToAccountMap; lines whose category is not in the map are tier C questions, never posted to offsetAccount without a decision
run duplicate_pairs against the card account ledger so a line already posted is not imported twice
propose one bulk import of the mapped lines (debit the expense account, credit cardAccount) and write the workbook

done.text: Every proposed entry balances: the expense lines equal the card account credit
The spreadsheet columns mapped without ambiguity and none required is missing
Every exception row cites the spreadsheet row number and the category that did not map or the ledger line it duplicates
card-import.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Unmapped categories are questions, not postings; lines already in the ledger are skipped and listed

tierRules.when: every line's category maps to a chart-of-accounts name in the map
a line's category is not in the map
